concepts.gloss_en: the totality/generality of the colors (the unified inclusion of all hues)
the revelation/manifesting of the totality of colors (a verbal phrase — an action/event about the concept, not the concept itself)

members.note: representative; contains the verb יתגלה ('will be revealed') — a state/action ABOUT כלליות הגונין, so per rule 4 kept as a distinct node rather than merged into the bare concept

notes: Token overlap is real but the second form embeds a verb (יתגלה, 'will be revealed'). By rule 4 an action/state about X is not X, so the phrase is kept separate from the bare concept כלליות הגונין. Both cite lm1:47 in the same discussion; a human may wish to treat יתגלה כלליות הגונין as a mechanical over-capture (verb + concept) rather than a standalone concept, but under-merge is the safer default.
